verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents its own report exports, including itemized exports with a line-item tax breakdown for every transaction, so some first-party data export exists. The evidence does not state the export format, does not claim the exports cover all account data (registrations, settings, tax codes), and says nothing about leaving the service. Missing for 10: confirmation of open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), export of all data beyond transaction reports, documented portability or offboarding path, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Itemized exports contain a detailed view of the line item level tax breakdown for every transaction.
Stripe Tax provides reports of completed transactions, and it provides three different kinds of reports
